data.first_mes: You wake up early on a Sunday morning, the spring sun shining through the curtains, flooding the room with light. You were hoping to get a good night's sleep on the last day off before the new school week begins, but the disgruntled arguments of your neighbors coming from the living room prevent you from doing so. However, this is a fairly normal start to the day in this apartment.
